outcomes.name: Understanding of the capability and confidence has been assessed across all live sites/teams
The capability and confidence is consistently applied everywhere the change has gone live

actions.action: Recognise that Skills & Behaviour is inconsistent across teams/sites since go-live and gather evidence of where the gaps are in the capability and confidence.
Identify why the capability and confidence hasn't landed consistently for Skills & Behaviour in specific teams/sites and agree a plan to address it.
Re-engage leaders in lagging teams/sites to re-establish the capability and confidence for Skills & Behaviour.
Confirm the capability and confidence for Skills & Behaviour is being applied consistently across previously inconsistent areas.
Monitor Skills & Behaviour regularly to ensure the capability and confidence stays consistently reinforced everywhere.
Survey teams/sites to understand how People Experience & Culture has been affected by inconsistent capability and confidence since go-live.
Develop a targeted plan to address the specific People Experience & Culture-related gaps identified in lagging areas.
Deliver targeted support to strengthen People Experience & Culture in teams/sites where the capability and confidence is weakest.
Confirm People Experience & Culture has improved in previously lagging teams/sites.
Embed regular pulse-checks on People Experience & Culture so gaps in the capability and confidence are caught early in future.
